course_description: Study of fundamental data structures, recursive algorithms, dynamic memory, sorting, trees, and algorithmic complexity.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement standard sorting algorithms to organize unstructured data sets efficiently.
Analyze the time and space complexity of recursive functions and dynamic memory operations.
Develop balanced binary tree structures to optimize search and retrieval processes for hierarchical data.
Evaluate dynamic memory allocation strategies for high-performance computing tasks involving large datasets.
